notes: Card: top-32 peak ' �' x31 before Korean syllables (치, 애, 패, 네, 야) and spaced katakana (ソ). Probes: 치료 0.78, 패스워드 0.57, ' ソフトウェア' 0.53, ' ニュース' 0.49 with spaces but 0.00 for the same Japanese without spaces; Korean made only of common syllables (우리 회사는 새로운 컴퓨터 ...) 0.09; Chinese and English ~0.
